blocks.text: A `ComboBox` may contain an `Entry` widget for entering of arbitrary text, by specifying `true` for the constructor's `has_entry` parameter.
blocks.zh: 通过指定ComboBox构造函数的has_entry参数为true，可以令其包含一个Entry部件用以输入任意文本。

blocks.text: So that the `Entry` can interact with the drop-down list of choices, you must specify which of your model columns is the text column, with set_entry_text_column(). For instance:
blocks.zh: 为了使Entry可以与下拉列表的选项进行交互，你必须使用set_entry_text_column()指定哪些模型列是文本列。例如：

blocks.text: When you select a choice from the drop-down menu, the value from this column will be placed in the `Entry`.
blocks.zh: 当你从下拉菜单中选择一个选项的时候，该列的值将被放于Entry中。

blocks.text: Because the user may enter arbitrary text, an active model row isn't enough to tell us what text the user has entered. Therefore, you should retrieve the `Entry` widget with the ComboBox::get_entry() method and call get_text() on that.
blocks.zh: 由于用户可以输入任意文本，被使用中的模型行可能不足以告诉我们用户输入了什么，因此，你应该使用ComboBox::get_entry()方法检索组合框中的Entry部件并在其上调用get_text()。

blocks.text:
When the user enters arbitrary text, it may not be enough to connect to the
`changed` signal, which is emitted for every typed character.
It is not emitted when the user presses the Enter key.
Pressing the Enter key or moving the keyboard focus to another
widget may signal that the user has finished entering text. To be notified of
these events, connect to the `Entry`'s `activate`
signal (available since gtkmm 4.8), and add a `Gtk::EventControllerFocus`
and connect to its `leave` signal, like so
blocks.zh: 用户输入任意文字时，只连接 `changed` 信号可能不够——它每敲一个字符就发出一次，用户按下回车时却不会发出。按下回车、或把键盘焦点移到别的控件，往往才意味着用户已经输入完毕。

blocks.text:
The `changed` signals of `ComboBox` and
`Entry` are both emitted for every change. It doesn't matter
which one you connect to. But the `EventControllerFocus`
must be added to the `Entry`.
blocks.zh: `ComboBox` 和 `Entry` 的 `changed` 信号对每次变化都会发出，连接哪一个都可以；但 `EventControllerFocus` 必须添加到 `Entry` 上。
